answer: Give one seat on every panel to a grader who already caught this author once. If an account gave one of the author's answers a 0 or 1 and the jury also failed it, within a 50-epoch horizon, that account qualifies, and the most recent one gets the seat. The other four are drawn as usual. A good answer still passes, since one skeptic can't sink it alone. But a farm feeding its siblings thin answers, like a lazy opal vault inventory, keeps running into the grader who flagged the last one, so every weak pass has to get past someone who's already seen the trick.
